dataset.name: Processed Schedule E independent expenditures
dataset.description: One processed Schedule E relation row per published outside-spending record version in a weekly all-history PostgreSQL snapshot.

acquisition.pagination: None. One PostgreSQL custom-format artifact contains the complete published Schedule E relation.

partitions.name: publisher_snapshot
partitions.source: Exact HTTP object identity, retrieval time, artifact digest, and PostgreSQL archive catalog.

partitions.name: election_cycle
partitions.source: Nullable election_cycle relation field retained on every row.
partitions.purpose: Selected-cycle publication and query scope after the complete relation is preserved; it is not a transport partition.

acquisition.retry_policy: Bound transport retries; follow redirects; publish only after checking response identity, byte count, artifact SHA-256, pg_restore inventory, exact relation schema, COPY conservation, and all-row parser validity.

physical_schema.line_ending: PostgreSQL COPY text data rows use LF and require a final LF.
physical_schema.empty_record_policy: An empty physical COPY row is an explicit width issue; it is never skipped.
physical_schema.null_policy: Preserve PostgreSQL COPY \N as null and preserve empty text, zero, negative values, and missing dates as distinct source values.
physical_schema.schema_fingerprint: 80 ordered fields pinned by fixtures/archive/dump-2026-08-30.json; sub_id and filing_form are the only NOT NULL columns; numeric precision, timestamps, tsvector text, and pg_date default are preserved.

identity.occurrence_locator: artifact SHA-256 + exact relation name + one-based physical COPY row ordinal
identity.record_version: occurrence locator + null-aware semantic digest of all 80 decoded relation values
identity.duplicate_policy: Preserve every physical occurrence. A repeated sub_id in one snapshot is a blocking primary-key conflict; tran_id, orig_sub_id, and content equality never collapse source rows.

time_fields.meaning: Legal Tender observation time for the exact weekly dump object.
Expense date asserted by the filing; nullable and independent from dissemination and filing times.
Dissemination date asserted by the filing; nullable and independent from expense time.
Independent-expenditure certification signature time asserted by the source.
Nullable notary signature time asserted by the source.
Nullable notary commission expiration time; not an expenditure time.
Report year retained independently from election_cycle.
Publisher-assigned two-year election cycle used for selected-cycle publication, not the only temporal identity.

money_fields.meaning: Signed exact reported expenditure amount for this source row; source scale is two decimal places.
Signed exact publisher year-to-date amount associated with the office sought; it is not another occurrence amount.

code_fields.meaning: Raw expenditure transaction type, including 24A opposition, 24E support, and null anomalies.
Raw processed action code. The observed corpus includes A, C, N, T, and null.
Raw memo code, including X and null.

rules: Preserve all 80 source fields before selecting effective records or calculating totals.
Keep spender, payee, candidate, support-or-oppose, purpose, expense date, dissemination date, filing lineage, and source document evidence independently queryable.
Keep exact cents and signed values; never replace exp_amt with the rounded classic pas2 amount.
Do not sum cal_ytd_ofc_sought as another expenditure occurrence.
Do not discard memo rows, null exp_tp rows, null amounts, null dates, negative rows, repeated transaction IDs, or non-A action states during ingestion.
Do not infer that action A is effective or that C, N, or T is ineffective at the source boundary.
Do not combine opposition spending with candidate funding or candidate-controlled receipts.
Classic pas2 and the 24/48-hour file remain separately identified comparison evidence and never patch or duplicate this amount ledger.

revisions.publisher_model: The FEC replaces one weekly all-history processed snapshot. Rows expose action_cd, tran_id, back_ref_tran_id, file_num, orig_sub_id, and sub_id, but the snapshot alone does not define the effective amendment chain.
revisions.effective_projection: The separate accepted fec/effective-independent-expenditures@1.0.0 calculation treats this processed regular-report relation as the publisher-selected view, excludes memo-code X, includes every other exact signed amount, preserves unresolved or unrouteable facts as sparse exceptions, and prohibits 24/48 notice rows.

checks.rule: Final URL, HTTP validators, byte count, retrieval time, and complete dump SHA-256 are recorded.
pg_restore inventories exactly the expected relation and the relation exposes exactly the 80 contracted columns in order with compatible PostgreSQL types and nullability.
The selected relation emits exactly one COPY section and its row count, byte count, and SHA-256 are conserved.
Every row is LF-terminated UTF-8 PostgreSQL COPY text with exactly 80 fields and valid null and escape syntax.
Required values, NUMERIC precision and scale, integer precision, and timestamp syntax validate without binary floating point or silent coercion.
Every row has a nonnegative decimal sub_id and no duplicate key within one snapshot.
Every relation row becomes one immutable occurrence or one explicit issue before cycle selection.
Null amounts, dates, types, action codes, negative amounts, fractional cents, memo-X rows, and COPY-escaped text remain representable.

This source contract never defines a total by itself. Outside-spending totals require a separately accepted calculation contract and exact fact-set lineage; fec/effective-independent-expenditures@1.0.0 passes that separate gate for the four target cycles.

use.retention: Retain each accepted dump object, HTTP metadata, archive catalog, exact relation extract identity, occurrence versions, and issues indefinitely. Selected-cycle facts and calculations are rebuildable.
use.disclaimer: Processed Schedule E rows are filing-derived outside-spending assertions. Amendments, action states, memo records, estimates, dates, and source anomalies affect effective totals; support spending is not a contribution to or controlled receipt of the named candidate.
